verdict.rationale: Datadog is a monitoring platform that could plausibly ship automations, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack never describes versioning, review, or rollback of automations. The Audit Trail and Monitors entries are bare titles with no content on version history or rollback, and an audit log is an adjacent control in any case, not automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
